name: VESTA
definition: A method for extracting isosurfaces from 3D voxel data by constructing a wire frame of N-cycles (closed loops of voxel faces) that enclose active voxels, which are then triangulated into a non-degenerate, volume-enclosing surface.
summary: VESTA is a surface extraction algorithm that generates closed, hole-free isosurfaces by resolving voxel ambiguities, unlike Marching Cubes.
